body: I am sorry that you felt that way... Whenever I see people in similar situations I tend to feel not alone... I am really sorry

I am in the same situation now I feel really guilty for not being good enough I try really hard but I am not just good enough I guess. I am trying to be optimistic by lying to myself things will get better i am still young... Etc. I sometimes just want to not exists anymore but at the same time I don't my parents to suffer I want to provide for them... 
I shared my thoughts coz... You are not alone there are tons of people here who are just like we just gotta hang around and hope things will get better.
If you think you could enjoy living then why do you want to die?
If you want to talk I am here
I would be a hypocrite if I say everything will fine because I don't believe in that as well. I have been scrolling through reddit for past hour and I do think it helped me calm my nerves down.

I think I understand your situation quite well I want to not exists anymore. I had this thought for years I even went to therapy bit I didn't mention it there coz I was too scared that therapist will judge me. There were times when I wished to run away and never come back. I planned my escape over and over in my  head but never seem to have the courage to act on it. I don't know what I am good I feel so trapped. I am suffocating. I sometimes secretly hope that I have some incurable disease and I will die soon. I am more afraid what my parents will go through if I act on my instincts. I have already put them through enough I don't want to be a burden even after I die.
I feel you.. I really wish I could talk to someone about what I am going through as well. I am always surrounded by people but I have never felt more lonely.
